description: Detach a skill from an agent. An organization skill stays in the organization for other agents; a catalog skill attached to this agent alone is deleted with the attachment. The agent is rebuilt so it stops carrying the skill. Detaching a skill that is not attached changes nothing. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the agent belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

skill.description: Required. The skill's name, or a ref such as catalog:<name> or org:<name>.

name: detach_skill
title: Detach a skill from an agent
